findings.title: The governed token hash binds checkout-specific CRLF bytes instead of the immutable candidate
findings.reproduction: At planning/enabler-change-requests/ECR-0007.packet.json:282, governedExperience binds design/ui-reference/assets/tokens.css to SHA-256 475da960ade048a4a0989dfd42cbcae974b82aedc7b13e18af77e6216bdff230, and planning/review-site/enablers/ECR-0007.html:86 repeats it. On this Windows checkout, Get-FileHash returns that value because the worktree file is 5,552 CRLF bytes. Hashing the immutable bytes from `git show 3d868e579ba23a833f3a71650cd77f5f71c632b3:design/ui-reference/assets/tokens.css` returns e6aa1ebf847e983f4f5c9d20ad0e753716737cdfbedf617df2292bf510bebfa5 over 5,344 bytes; design/ui-reference/REFERENCE_MANIFEST.yaml:90 independently binds the same e6aa1ebf value. The pending ECR validator reads only checkout bytes, so it reports success, but the approved-history path supplies packet_commit and tools/planctl.py:740-741 then compares the candidate Git blob with the checkout payload. An approval created for this candidate would therefore fail its own immutable-packet validation, and the packet does not presently authenticate the exact approved token authority it claims to reaffirm unchanged.
findings.requiredRemediation: Create a strict-descendant R02 proposal candidate that binds assets/tokens.css to the repository-stable approved digest e6aa1ebf847e983f4f5c9d20ad0e753716737cdfbedf617df2292bf510bebfa5 and regenerates the human-review page, generated ECR page, indexes, and manifest. Repair the generic v4 bound-file generation/validation path so pending and approved validation use one Git/canonical-byte semantic independent of checkout EOL conversion, with a focused Windows CRLF versus immutable-blob regression test; route that control correction through the bounded governance-maintenance workflow if required. Preserve this adverse R01 ledger append-only and obtain a new exact-commit independent review before requesting human approval.

verified: The exact candidate 3d868e579ba23a833f3a71650cd77f5f71c632b3 has sole parent 844e17bf7e4d2986dd7f37ee72efe25cbc4326ee. Its eight-path delta adds only the canonical ECR-0007 proposal, v4 packet, static review page, generated ECR page and four generated review-site indexes/manifests; it changes no backlog, Wave/task state, product, UI-reference, ADR, architecture, public contract, verification tool, approval, or predecessor-authority file. Git diff hygiene passes.

The packet itself has SHA-256 a397f43c2eaaca765865b2fade8f1a57c0006f45da28e112b2bed3d6d9ab52cb and Git blob a0bbc07aaa8fdca5f75210f818aa82ce68fd7d57. The proposal SHA-256 e4dbcbb204eacd9e807885ec1cf728bfeb05c8da1159d39958bfbd60341e06ee, v4 schema SHA-256 69b378e5958e460354ec523fe23bfcdae11b1e321388e41bd101ce1d9f20f347, and static review SHA-256 525826e787f1a6b7bc78a74eb8e57981a60c43d5a73620392890c3f44b801408 match their immutable candidate bytes. The S01/T01/T02 inventory is decision-complete for the authorized correction. It enumerates all currently implemented W1 surfaces, one canonical token source, semantic reusable primitives, logical properties and bounded specificity, the exact desktop/compact/200%-effective viewport matrix, light/dark/reduced-motion/focus/keyboard/zoom/reflow obligations, semantic rather than pixel-identical tolerances, fail-closed live-product and style-reuse negatives, independent task/slice/exit reviews, and an experience/quality checkpoint. Rollback and non-goals prohibit reference-baseline rewrites, tolerance/allowlist escape, product-semantic or architecture expansion, later-Wave pages, major framework churn, release action, and hidden adverse-history deletion.

The approved RO-UI-ACADEMIC-MINIMAL-1.5 geometry and experience statements are factually grounded: the reference specifies the 4px scale, 64px top bar, 240/72px navigation, 28/20/16px responsive page padding, 16px grid, 24-32px section rhythm, 16/20px cards and 40/44px controls.
